lines: Peete hain na muflis hi, na daulat wale
Pee kar jo maza lete hain qismat wale
couplets.en: Rich or poor, only the fortunate know the pleasure of the cup.

lines: Jo hosh ki daldal mein hain, woh kya jaanein
Is paar se kis paar gaye matwale
couplets.en: How can those mired in sobriety know what shore the wine-drunk have reached?

lines: Duniya hai hawa, saara bharam hai, saaqi
Ek aag hai, yeh umr alam hai, saaqi
couplets.en: Cupbearer, the world is air and illusion, and this life burns with sorrow.

lines: Paani ki tarah paak hain, lekin
Ek din mil jaayenge mitti mein, yeh gham hai, saaqi
couplets.en: Pure as water, cupbearer, we grieve that one day we will mingle with the dust.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
Yeh chaandni ka dukh hai, magar tu samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass, though the sorrow is the moonlight's.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Raaton ko tootte hue taaron ka gham na kar
Raaton ko tootte hue taaron ka gham na kar
couplets.en: Do not grieve for the stars that fall in the night.

lines: Raaton ko tootte hue taaron ka gham na kar
Palkon pe uski yaad ke jugnu, samet le
couplets.en: Let the stars fall through the night and gather the fireflies of remembrance on your lashes.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Sab jagmagaate khwaab fizaaon mein uchhaal de
couplets.en: Cast every shimmering dream into the open air.

lines: Sab jagmagaate khwaab fizaaon mein uchhaal de
Sooraj ke ehtiraam mein pehlu, samet le
couplets.en: Cast every shimmering dream into the open air and draw yourself in before the sun.

lines: Bikhre pade hain ghaas pe aansoo, samet le
couplets.en: Gather the tears scattered on the grass.

lines: Kaali ghata ko khul ke barasna naseeb ho
Kaali ghata ko khul ke barasna naseeb ho
couplets.en: May the dark cloud have its chance to pour.

lines: Kaali ghata ko khul ke barasna naseeb ho
Ya Rab, zameen ki pyaas agar tu samet le
couplets.en: Lord, if you would take away the earth's thirst, grant the dark cloud leave to pour.
